name: 77447 · Hockley, TX
findings: ZIP 77447 (Hockley) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77447 (Hockley) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 77447 (Hockley) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 29% of the typical level).
